system.description: As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to coat either your own or an allied creatures weapon in a super-heated layer of scorching flames for the next minute. The affected weapons [Weapon Damage] becomes 1d12, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Weapon Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.
